vectors.description: A healthy Tier 0 envelope passes.
An expired envelope is rejected.
An unsupported protocol version is rejected before anything else.
A malformed nonce (not matching nonce:<32 hex>) is rejected.
issued_at more than 5 minutes in the future is a clock-skew rejection.
An empty agent id fails the semantic schema check.
A valid Ed25519 signature verifies.
Verifying against the wrong public key fails.
A tampered payload (post-signing) fails signature verification.
A valid HMAC signature verifies at Tier 0.
A fresh nonce is accepted.
The same nonce used twice is rejected the second time.
A permitted trade within every limit passes (through Tier 1 asset truth).
An action absent from a non-empty allowlist is rejected.
A denied action is rejected even if also allowed elsewhere.
An amount over the per-transaction limit is rejected (1500 > 1000, but still under the 2000 per-day limit, isolating this to E202).
An amount that would exceed the rolling per-day limit is rejected.
A request outside the agent's time window is rejected.
A request from outside the agent's permitted geography is rejected.
An asset class outside the permitted set is rejected.
A clean, unrevoked agent passes.
A revoked agent is blocked.
A revoked agent is blocked even at Tier 0 — the kill switch is not tier-gated.
A suspended agent reports its own code.
A revoked issuer blocks the transaction.

A non-local revocation store that hasn't synced within the staleness budget fails closed rather than reporting not-revoked. Custos's highest-severity divergence from the reference implementation, which fails open here. The one vector in this suite that is not purely data-driven: staleness is measured against the real wall clock (an operational concern, unlike envelope timestamps), so the runner must sleep past requires_sleep_ms before verifying, exactly as tests/test_verification.py does for the same check.
An unknown asset (no claim) is rejected.
A known asset with no market observation fails closed.
An observation older than the maximum age is rejected.
A claim attested in the future is rejected.
A stale claim (older than the staleness threshold) is rejected.
A negative observed yield is impossible market data.
A claimed yield diverging beyond the relative threshold is rejected.
A backing ratio below the floor is rejected.
At a genuine 0.00% print, a small claimed yield within absolute tolerance passes.
A valid two-hop delegation chain with correct monotonicity passes.
A discontinuous chain is rejected.
An expired delegation hop is rejected.
A hop widening its authority beyond its delegator is rejected (real boundary monotonicity).
min_trust_score at the default of 0.0 never gates.
A fresh agent (trust score 0.0) fails a configured minimum threshold.
With no known-hash maps supplied, attestation is opt-in and trivially passes.
An unregistered framework is rejected.
A build_hash mismatch against the registered framework hash is rejected.
A system_prompt_hash mismatch against the registered hash is rejected.
Byte-exact canonical payload of a full envelope: whole floats become ints, keys sorted recursively (@ sorts first), no whitespace, Z-suffixed datetime, nulls present, proof excluded.
A whole float (500.0) normalizes to the JSON integer 500; a fractional float (45.5) is untouched.
A Decimal is carried through Pydantic as a JSON string, preserving exactness.
Keys sort recursively and lexicographically; '@' (U+0040) sorts before all letters.
null is emitted for a None field, never omitted.
